budget_rule.additional_clause_order: retrieval ranks two through five, then selected clause order
budget_rule.overflow: stop admitting optional clauses before the first overflow; never truncate a clause
budget_rule.protected: all Run 014 selected clauses from rank one, plus the first selected clause from every lower-rank record
budget_rule.protected_overflow: retain protected clauses even if they exceed the target
budget_rule.provenance: full records remain in SQLite; the isolated replay records every retained and omitted source clause

embedding_queue_rule.update_timing: after initial enqueue and before model loading or worker claim

hypothesis: A pending document update can supersede its stale embedding job, expose only the latest FTS5 content, and attach only the newest vector and cache key while preserving Run 024 retrieval.
measurement_notes: CPU is process CPU time and may exceed wall time with two inference threads.
RSS is the Linux process-lifetime high-water mark in MiB; baseline runs before loading the embedding runtime.
End-to-end query time includes query embedding, retrieval, fusion when selected, supersession filtering and compact context assembly; it excludes answer generation.
The fusion rule and its constants were selected before evaluation and were not tuned against benchmark labels.
Context tokens use the chars/4 approximation and held-out evidence uses the existing evidence-term subset proxy.
The 40-document, 40-query experiment does not establish large-corpus scale or broad generalization.
notes: Rejected as a pending-supersession extension to Run 24: latest-content provenance, stale-job isolation, final parity, or a resource gate failed.

vector_storage.candidate_index: sqlite-vec int8[384] with per-vector max-absolute scaling
vector_storage.query_quantization: max-absolute int8 for candidate search; FP32 for reranking
vector_storage.rerank_corpus_precision: float16 storage converted to float32 for scoring
vector_storage.rerank_distance: cosine computed in FP32 from stored FP16 corpus vectors and FP32 query
